answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the consensus kernel enforces a quadratic stake-burning auction: an identity must burn S_i = k * i^2 native tokens to forge its i-th identity. As an adversary attempts to reach the zenith of influence by spinning up n colluding nodes, total burned capital scales superlinearly at O(n^3), imposing exponential economic friction that renders mass identity fabrication mathematically unsustainable.
